title: The Breath
label: ch:ka-usiru
canDo: I can recognise the seven Kannada consonants that carry the breath, and say which plain letter each one is built on.

payoff.summary: From cold: pair each of the seven breathy consonants with the plain letter it is built on, and say why the romanization's ph is not the f of phone.
payoff.note: The chapter introduces exactly these seven atoms and the payoff assesses all seven. Seven characters, one move: it is deliberately one idea per chapter rather than thirteen atoms in one, which would have broken the twelve-per-chapter budget.
